question: Should legacy ID-only Skill Workshop approval requests automatically bind to the proposal version current when the approval prompt is created?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but automatic binding intentionally changes the concurrent-revision outcome of an existing approval flow and establishes a durable lifecycle contract.

options.title: Keep automatic binding
options.body: Preserve ID-only direct-call compatibility while approval prompts snapshot the current version and reject later proposal drift.

options.title: Require explicit review binding
options.body: Only callers that pass proposal_version become drift-bound, leaving legacy approval prompts unchanged.

options.title: Split preview from binding
options.body: Land exact proposal preview first and defer automatic approval parameter rewriting to separate work.

recommendation.title: Keep automatic binding
recommendation.body: Preserve ID-only direct-call compatibility while approval prompts snapshot the current version and reject later proposal drift.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history most directly connects this person to Skill Workshop approval routing, prompt contracts, and the affected hook behavior.
